groups.saying_opens: هذا نصف العلم لأن الدنيا بر وبحر

notes: Two sayings: the Prophet's words on the sea (saying 1) and Abu Ubayda's on half of knowledge (saying 2), each with its own isnad (rule 4a).
«بلغني» is a marked gap (rule 8). «قال أبو عبد الله» is the compiler's own remark (rule 13), so he is not written.
«من آل ابن الأزرق» describes Sa'id's family, not a link; «وهو من بني عبد الدار» is an editor gloss.
